en: If you tap an icon and drag it along{SAUT}{f 0 1 2}while the pencil tool is selected{f 0 1 0}...{PAGE}Then you can {f 0 1 2}place that icon on the map{f 0 1 0}.{PAGE}For example, you can mark shortcuts with{SAUT}their own designated {f 0 1 2}icon{f 0 1 0}.{PAGE}That icon will {f 0 1 2}automatically display{f 0 1 0}{SAUT}the travel direction of the shortcut.
Any icons placed by mistake can be{SAUT}deleted by {f 0 1 2}dragging them to the trash can{f 0 1 0}.
A mistake in drawing walls or floors is{SAUT}fixed with the {f 0 1 2}UNDO button{f 0 1 0}.

Your map has many other functions{SAUT}as well. Details can be found under{SAUT}{f 0 1 2}HELP{f 0 1 0} at the map's bottom right.{SAUT}Don't forget to fill it in as you{SAUT}explore; you'll thank yourself later!
